syncgroups.config.tags.tip: Show the group name next to a server in the multiplayer list.
syncgroups.config.mode.tip:
How data reaches a server.

Copies — on join the files are copied to the server, on leave they go back to the group. Server folders stay ordinary.

Symlinks — the server folder becomes a link to the shared group folder: every server works on the same files, nothing is copied.
syncgroups.config.mode.applied.symlink: Symlinks enabled — folders are being converted in the background
syncgroups.config.mode.applied.copy: Copies enabled — folders are being converted in the background
syncgroups.config.mode.deferred: Mode saved, folders will be converted on the next launch
syncgroups.config.push.tip: How often data is saved to the group while playing. The more often, the less is lost on a crash.
syncgroups.config.openFolder.tip: Open config/syncgroups — groups, backups and the diagnostics log live there.
